summary: A low-temperature plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) process is demonstrated to synthesize high-quality 2D MoS2 films with tuneable morphology. The process enables precise thickness control down to a monolayer and allows for the transformation of film morphology from in-plane to out-of-plane orientation, which is beneficial for electrocatalytic applications such as the hydrogen evolution reaction.
